Privacy policy

Demonstration content. Details below are fictional and must be replaced before a real site goes live.

How this demonstration handles your data

Everything you type into the fee estimator and booking drawer stays in your browser. There is no server, no analytics and no tracking script on this page.

Storage on your device

Only your language choice and cookie preferences are saved, using localStorage. You can remove them at any time through your browser settings or the cookie settings link in the footer.

Your rights

For a live site, a controller would need to provide details on access, rectification, deletion and complaint rights here, along with a contact address.
